titleEn: The Secret of the Ancient Library

beats.beat: The CHILD steps into the grand historical library of the city, captivated by tall arched shelves and quiet golden sunlight.
While exploring the children's section, a beautifully embroidered vintage bookmark slips out of a heavy illustrated book.
The bookmark features delicate Arabic calligraphy and a subtle sketch of an ornate carved wooden door.
On the back of the bookmark is a playful rhyming riddle hinting at a hidden corner where old maps rest.
The CHILD quietly follows the clues between high rows of books, decoding symbols connected to their favorite interests.
Along the way, the friendly librarian winks and points toward a spiral staircase leading to the sunny mezzanine.
At the top of the stairs, the CHILD finds an ancient carved desk with a polished brass kaleidoscope and leather-bound atlas.
Looking through the kaleidoscope, colourful geometric Arabesque patterns shift and reveal the final clue.
The clue leads to a special carved bookshelf that holds the 'Book of Curious Explorers'.
Inside the book is an honorary ledger where young readers write down their biggest dreams for the future.
The CHILD proudly adds their name and drawing to the historical ledger using a shiny wooden fountain pen.
The librarian presents the CHILD with a small golden reader pin in recognition of their inquisitive mind and teamwork.
The CHILD borrows a stack of thrilling adventure tales to take home and read with their family.
Walking out through the library courtyard, the city feels alive with stories waiting to be discovered everywhere.
At home, the CHILD gazes proudly at their golden pin, eager for their next great reading journey.
